name: calc_buying_cost
description: Calculate the true cost of buying a residential property in England or Northern Ireland: Stamp Duty (SDLT) including the 2% non-UK-resident surcharge and the 5% additional-property surcharge, plus deposit, legal/survey/mortgage fees, Land Registry, the monthly mortgage repayment, and the total cash needed on completion day. ALWAYS call this tool for any figure. NEVER estimate or calculate stamp duty yourself — SDLT is a multi-band marginal tax and a guessed number would be wrong.

price.description: Purchase price in GBP, as a plain integer (e.g. 850000).

buyer.description: standard = this will be their only home (they own no other property anywhere, or are replacing their main residence). first_time = they have never owned a property anywhere in the world. additional = they will own more than one property after this purchase (a second home, a buy-to-let, or they already own a home ANYWHERE INCLUDING OVERSEAS). Ask if unclear — overseas property counts, and buyers usually don't know that.

non_resident.description: 1 if the buyer has been present in the UK fewer than 183 days in the 12 months before completion (this is about days in the UK, NOT nationality or visa). 0 if UK-resident.

deposit_pct.description: Deposit as a whole percentage of the price (e.g. 25). Omit unless the visitor stated one; omitting it applies a 10% deposit.

rate.description: Mortgage interest rate as a percentage, e.g. "4.5". Omit unless stated; omitting it applies 4.5%.

years.description: Mortgage term in years. Omit unless stated; omitting it applies 25 years.
